title: King of Comedy
summary: A village beauty and a struggling actor work with their neighbours to protect a coastal community from a redevelopment plan and find new ways to revive the local economy.
trailerLabel: Official iQIYI series page and available previews
whyFans: The ensemble mixes comedy with everyday challenges facing a local community.
The coastal-community setting leaves room for business schemes and comic misunderstandings.
The group dynamic gives the story space for contrasting personalities and running jokes.
review: King of Comedy is built around a community problem and an ensemble, giving the comedy a clear goal rather than relying only on punchlines. Its appeal will depend on how naturally the characters' rivalries and friendships grow out of that situation. Viewers looking for a lighter series may enjoy the mix of local-life details and broad comedy.
